## From the guard on post to the invoice in your ERP. Zero manual steps with TrackTik.

Every action in TrackTik feeds the next, with no re-entry, no reconciliation sprint, and no back-office chaos. It is the only platform in the industry that connects all five steps in one continuous, automated flow.

GPS-verified, NFC-confirmed, timestamped automatically from mobile.

Step 02

### Patrol verified

Checkpoints scanned, incidents filed, runsheet completed in real time.

Step 03

### Hours flow to billing

Step 04

Per contract rules, integrated with your payroll and accounting.

Step 05

Our advanced reporting engine allows you to expose critical data to make operations more effective and efficient.

Frequently asked questions

## Your questions, answered.

What is TrackTik?

TrackTik is the Trackforce platform for security workforce management. It connects frontline guarding activity to your financial back office in one system, so the guard clocking in, the patrol being verified, the incident report, the hours flowing to billing, and the invoice reaching your ERP all run as one continuous, automated flow instead of five disconnected tools.

Does TrackTik support multiple locations and countries?

Yes. TrackTik is deployed in more than 50 countries and supports 55 languages, giving you a single standardized view across every site, vendor, and country rather than a separate system per region. The [command center](https://www.trackforce.com/products/tracktik/command-center/) shows live guard coverage, open incidents, and SLA performance across all sites in one screen.

Who is TrackTik designed for?

Two groups. [Security firms](https://www.trackforce.com/who-we-serve/organization-types/security-firms/) that deliver guarding services and need to protect margin, prove service delivery to clients, and win larger contracts. And [enterprise security teams](https://www.trackforce.com/who-we-serve/organization-types/enterprise-security/) accountable for a program in house who need one standardized view across sites, vendors, and countries.

How long does implementation take?

Typical time to launch is 6 to 8 weeks. You get a dedicated onboarding lead, data migration and system integration handled by the Trackforce team, and role specific training for command staff and supervisors through TrackTik Academy. Timelines scale with how many modules you turn on and how complex your data migration is. See [professional services](https://www.trackforce.com/support/professional-services/) for what is included.

How much does TrackTik cost?

TrackTik is quoted for your operation, based on what you need. You can start with tours and reporting, then add billing, payroll, business intelligence, or visitor management whenever you are ready. [Request pricing](https://www.trackforce.com/products/tracktik/pricing/) and a specialist follows up within one business day.

Is there a mobile app for guards?

Yes. Guards work from a mobile app on iOS and Android that walks them through each tour step by step, captures activity the moment it happens, confirms checkpoints with GPS and NFC, and alerts supervisors to missed checkpoints or incidents in real time. Learn more about the [guard tour app](https://www.trackforce.com/products/tracktik/security-guard-tour-app/).

Does TrackTik integrate with payroll, ERP, and other tools?

Yes, with two way sync and no double entry. Payroll and HR connectors include ADP, Paycor, and Criterion. ERP and accounting include QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, Xero, Amaka, and Bass. Security and monitoring include Immix, RightCrowd, and Scylla AI. Anything outside the directory can be built on a fully documented REST API with real time webhooks. See all [integrations](https://www.trackforce.com/products/integrations/).

Can we see a demo before purchasing?

Yes. You can book a 30 minute live walkthrough of the command center, scheduling, billing, and business intelligence, mapped to how your operation actually runs. [Get a demo](https://www.trackforce.com/get-a-demo/) to schedule one.
